How a School Collaboration Works

A clear four-step process, from the first conversation to a programme your teachers can run with confidence.

  1. 01Step 1

    Share your goals

    Tell us the class groups, subjects and dates you have in mind.

  2. 02Step 2

    Plan with an advisor

    A programme advisor suggests a scope, format and budget range.

  3. 03Step 3

    Run a pilot session

    Start with one workshop or lab session so your team can see it in action.

  4. 04Step 4

    Agree the programme

    Confirm a term plan or MoU, with scope and pricing in writing.
